title: Preclinical evaluation of PSMA-targeted ultrasound contrast agents in an orthotopic model of prostate cancer in rabbits

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Preclinical evaluation of PSMA-targeted ultrasound contrast agents in an orthotopic model of prostate cancer in rabbits》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-3】We investigated prostate-specific membrane antigen (PSMA)-targeted lipid-shelled perfluorocarbon nanobubbles (PSMA-NBs) in an orthotopic rabbit model using a clinical contrast-enhanced ultrasound (CEUS) system.

evidence.text: We investigated prostate-specific membrane antigen (PSMA)-targeted lipid-shelled perfluorocarbon nanobubbles (PSMA-NBs) in an orthotopic rabbit model using a clinical contrast-enhanced ultrasound (CEUS) system.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Preclinical evaluation of PSMA-targeted ultrasound contrast agents in an orthotopic model of prostate cancer in rabbits》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-8】In an exploratory analysis constrained by cohort size, PSMA-NB kinetics, notably MTT, tracked histology-defined tumor viability, and DT mapping showed spatially heterogeneous retention at the tumor periphery.

evidence.text: In an exploratory analysis constrained by cohort size, PSMA-NB kinetics, notably MTT, tracked histology-defined tumor viability, and DT mapping showed spatially heterogeneous retention at the tumor periphery.

sections.title: 主要结果
sections.text:
《Preclinical evaluation of PSMA-targeted ultrasound contrast agents in an orthotopic model of prostate cancer in rabbits》：结果的原文依据；数值与适用人群以引文为准。

【Abstract · abstract-1-10】This study demonstrates the potential of PSMA-NBs to characterize prostate cancer by molecularly targeted CEUS beyond that achieved with MBs at the doses used.
